info.title: Campaigns API
info.description:
## Overview
Legacy Campaigns APIs covering **Announcements** (immediate one-off broadcasts) and **Campaigns** (manual and automated marketing campaigns, scheduling, statistics, templates, and triggers). These are legacy `/v2` (Core) and `/business/marketing/v1` (marketing engine) routes.

Most `/v2/campaigns` and `/v2/scheduled_campaigns` operations require the staff member to have marketing permissions (`has_marketing_permissions`).

post.description:
## Overview
Broadcasts a message with an optional action button to up to 20 clients, delivered immediately to each client's conversation over email and/or SMS; trial businesses may target only one client, and the action button URL must point to the business livesite. Requires the staff member to have marketing permissions (`has_marketing_permissions`).

Available for **Staff tokens**.

action_text.description: Label for the action button (max 255 chars).

button_url.description: Action button URL. Host must match the business livesite (external links rejected).

conversation_ids.description: Optional comma-separated conversation UIDs; resolved from clients when omitted.

staff_id.description: UID of the sending staff member.

403.description: Forbidden - trial multi-client, bulk-action limit, or missing permission.

400.description: Bad Request - no valid clients supplied.

422.description: Unprocessable Entity - more than 20 clients or validation error.

## Overview
